INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

JANE and MARK sit on a couch.

JANE
I feel angry and betrayed because you lied to me about the money.

MARK
I am sorry. Tell me the truth about what you want.

JANE
We need to talk about our feelings. This is important and hard.

You hurt me. I don't know what to say.

JANE
We have to be honest. I just want you to understand.
